effect_description_eng:
＜Use Req. ([TS] trait)＞ (Specified cards let you ignore color requirements.)
[Security] Activate this card's [Main] effects.
[Main] By trashing 1 [TS] trait card from your hand, ＜Draw 2＞ (Draw 2 cards from your deck.) After, you may link this card or 1 [TS] trait card from your trash to 1 of your Digimon on the field without paying the cost.
link_effect_description_eng: ＜Security A. +1＞ ＜Reboot＞ [All Turns] When this [Vulcanusmon] would leave the battle area, by trashing 1 of its link cards, it doesn't leave.
